scope: Current rrrah-dedup exact-file integration suite; finite authored filesystem fixtures, not universal file/image coverage. Requalification after upstream validation-order and cancellation audit.
reviewed_contracts: Report.complete is false on cancellation, IO, source mutation or resource-limit issues. SymlinkSkipped and NotRegular exclusions do not by themselves indicate an incomplete scan under configured policy.
Existing verified-scan regression injects one-shot cancellation at every observed checkpoint, requires empty groups and incomplete status, then checks healthy retry.
Existing nested-root regression checks partition preservation under limits and cancellation.
Existing late-source-failure regression covers healthy groups surviving other source failures.
limitations: Ordinary scan may retain healthy partial results; callers must inspect complete and issues.
Stable observations are not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
This run does not validate all visual similarity paths, platforms, formats, or all 500 upstream repositories.
